subject.title: fix(telegram): DM lane stays dead after a wedged handler keeps it guarded; escalate to a supervised gateway restart

question: Should processRestartRequired become a permanent generic ChannelAccountSnapshot capability, or should Telegram request this recovery through a narrower owner-specific gateway seam?
rationale: The choice defines a public plugin/channel contract and grants channel status publishers influence over whole-gateway availability; repository policy cannot determine that permanent API direction without owner intent.

options.title: Keep the generic contract
options.body: Approve the additive snapshot field as a reusable channel-health capability after the rolling-budget and unmanaged-fallback defects are fixed.

options.title: Use a Telegram-owned seam
options.body: Replace the public snapshot field with a narrow injected restart request owned by Telegram while retaining the same hard-boundary recovery policy.

recommendation.title: Keep the generic contract
recommendation.body: Approve the additive snapshot field as a reusable channel-health capability after the rolling-budget and unmanaged-fallback defects are fixed.

likelyOwner.reason: The available review history most directly connects this person to the Telegram spool and polling lifecycle where the recovery signal originates.
